Done! I've created `src/routes/posts.js` with the `postPath(title)` function. It follows the exact pattern used in your app:

- **Imports** the `slugify` utility from `src/utils/slugify.js`
- **Exports** `postPath(title)` which returns `/posts/` + the URL-safe slug of the title
- **Uses the same slug rules** as the rest of the app (accent folding, "&" → "and", everything else → "-")

Example: `postPath("Getting Started & Tips")` → `/posts/getting-started-and-tips`
